text:
Eliot Turner: Need approval for a 30% discount + 6mo commit for ACME POC. CPQ is blocking — it wants a Discount_Reason__c and a Commit_Tier field filled. @Sarah Chen can you route?
Sarah Chen: Can you paste the ACV and expected seats? Also add a short business justification. Deal desk prefers template.
Eliot Turner: ACV ~ $36k ARR for the POC (6mo), 15 seats. Reason: strategic proof-of-concept with potential enterprise roll. Added short note in the opp.
Kevin Morales: FYI security SCR is asking for SSO and data retention details. That needs to be answered before legal signs. I can pull SSO config from the infra runbook.
Sarah Chen: Routing this as a pricing exception (special_terms) in Salesforce. Tagging with: Discount_Category=Strategic_POC, Commit_Length=6, Estimated_Savings=30%. Setting Discount_Reason__c="Strategic expansion POC - enterprise pilot".
Sarah Chen: Deal desk SLA for pricing exceptions: 24h for <50k, 72h for >50k. This one's under 50k so we'll aim 8h turnaround — pinging @DealBot for fast path.
DealBot: [automated] Pricing exception queued -> Queue: PricingExceptions_US. Required approvals: Sales Manager + Deal Desk. Escalation TTL: 8h if no response. Link: https://redwood.internal/deals/PR-176845
Ana Patel: Legal needs a short note on data processing (DPA) and any customer-requested addenda. If ACME requires data localization, that's a separate approval and may add 3-5 business days.
Eliot Turner: Noted. ACME asked about SOC2 and data residency in EU. We have SOC2 report and can offer EU region Dedicated in Private, but that adds cost. For POC they want hosted but EU region. Can legal pre-approve data transfer language for the POC?
Ana Patel: I can pre-approve a limited DPA amendment for the POC (no long-term commitments) — add tag Special_Terms=POC_DPA and set Term_Limit=6mo in the contract notes.
Kevin Morales: For CPQ, mapping snippet:
```
Discount_Reason__c = "Strategic expansion POC"
Commitment_Tier__c = "6-month"
Deal_Size__c = "36k"
Approval_Path__c = "SM->DealDesk"
```
Sarah Chen: Perfect. I'll update the SF opp and create the Discount Approval record. @Eliot Turner please add ACME legal contact email in the opp so Ana can loop them in.
Eliot Turner: Added legal contact: legal+acme@acme.com
Sarah Chen: Done. I set the CPQ approval route and attached the justification template. Status: Awaiting Sales Manager approval. :eyes:
DealBot: [automated] Sales Manager (J. Park) notified. Escalation to Deal Desk in 8h if not approved.
Eliot Turner: Thanks team — will follow up if no SM approval within 4h. If approved, we'll push to CPQ and get legal DPA signed concurrently.
Sarah Chen: Note for post-approval: update commit to Billing Commitments field and apply rate card override with reason code POC-EXCEPTION.
Kevin Morales: I'll start the SSO details doc and share link here once ready.
Ana Patel: I'll draft the POC DPA clause and attach to the opp. ETA 3-4 hours.
Eliot Turner: :thumbsup:
